content: Ʉbhɨ ʉrahiitya abhaatʉ kʉbha, bhasʉʉkɨ na kwigwa abhakangati na bhʉ ʉbhʉnaja. Bhiisiriryɨ kokora amangʼana amazʉmu gʉʉsi.
Ʉbhabhʉʉrɨrɨ bhatatʉka mʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi, bhatabha bhʉʉmani, bhabhɨ bhanyʉʉhu na bhasuuku kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi.

Nʉʉrʉ itwɨ itubheene, ɨkarɨ hanʉ twarɨ tʉkɨɨrɨ kumwisirirya Yɨɨsu, twarɨ bhageege, bhaangi na tʉkakangiribhwa. Twarɨ bhambʉʉsa bhɨ ɨnamba yo okokora amabhɨ na zeteemwa zʉzʉʉsi za kʉʉsɨ. Ubhwikari bhwɨtʉ bhwarɨ bhwʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ na rihari. Abhaatʉ bhakatwigatanɨra itwʉsi tʉkabhabhiihirirwa.
Nawe Mungu, Ʉmʉsabhuri wɨɨtʉ, akatwerecha ʉbhʉzʉmu nʉ ʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwazɨ, akatʉsabhʉra.
Ataatusabhwirɨ kʉ kʉbha ya amahocha gɨɨtʉ amazʉmu, nawe kʉ kʉbha yɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ. Atʉbhɨngukiryɨ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwɨtʉ, kukwibhurwa bhuhya nʉ ʉkʉbha nu ubhwikari ubhuhya kʉnzɨra ye Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.
Mungu akatwitɨrɨra ekoro yaazɨ kwa bhwaru, kʉhɨtɨra Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, Ʉmʉsabhuri wɨɨtʉ.
Akakorabhu, na kʉtʉbharɨra kʉbha bhe eheene kʉnzɨra yɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyazɨ, korereke tobhone kʉgabha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwa kemerano, chɨmbu ubhwisɨgi bhwɨtʉ bhʉrɨ.

Amangʼana gayo, nɨ‑ga amaheene. Nereenda awɨ ʉgakandikijɨ, korereke bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhamwisiriryɨ Mungu, bhagagwatɨ na kwikongʼeererya kokora amazʉmu. Amangʼana gayo nɨ‑mazʉmu, na ganu ubhwera kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi.
Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, ʉtaanɨ na zɨhaka ze ekegeege, zɨkɨrɨrɨ za amariina ga bhasʉʉkʉrʉ, iryʉmana na zɨhaka igʉrʉ wi imigirʉ ja Musa. Gayo gʉʉsi gataana bhwera bhwʉbhwʉsi.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akusiigirirya abhaatʉ, omoreche rwe embere na rwa kabhɨrɨ. Arɨɨbhɨ atakwigwa, umwangɨ.
Ʉramenya kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ ncha wuyo atigirɨ amaheene, ahaakora ʉbhʉbhɨ, itiniirɨ umwene.
Nɨɨndirɨ nijɨ kwikara mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Nikʉpʉʉri, ribhaga rye embeho. Nawe nɨramʉtʉma Aritɨma hamwɨ Tikikʉ ɨwaazʉ. Ariihikɨ ɨwaazʉ, awɨ wangʉhɨ kuuza Nikʉpʉʉri turumanɨ.
Ikongʼeererya kʉsakirya Zeena, ʉmʉkaari wurya wi imigirʉ, na Apooro. Ʉbhahɨ bhyʉsi bhyʉ ʉkʉbhasakirya mʉnzɨra, bhatasuuhirwa kegero.
Abhiisirirya abhakɨndichɨtʉ bhʉʉsi, bhɨɨgɨ kwikongʼeererya kokora amazʉmu, korereke bhasakiryɨ bhu ubhwɨndi bhwa amaheene. Bhareekorebhu, ubhwikari bhwabhʉ bhʉtakʉbha bhʉʉha.
Abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bharɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ hanʉ, bharakokeerya. Nangʉ awʉʉsi, ʉbhakeerye abhiisirirya abhasɨɨgwa bhʉʉsi. Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhya Mungu bhɨbhɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ.

footnotes.text: Ekoro Ɨndɨndu. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
